query:
SELECT i.team_id
          FROM kb_team_invitations i
         WHERE i.token = $1
           AND i.status = 'pending'
           AND i.revoked_at IS NULL
           AND i.expires_at > now()
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vw_invitee_invitations v
                        WHERE v.id = i.id AND v.invitee_profile_id = $2)
